$comment: CrewAI's MCP servers. `MCPServerAdapter({"url": ..., "transport": "streamable-http" | "sse", "headers": ...})` (from `crewai_tools`, installed with `crewai[tools]`), or a list of those, connects to each server and gives its tools; `StdioServerParameters` runs a local process and is not reported. `Agent(mcps=["https://...", MCPServerHTTP(url=..., headers=...), MCPServerSSE(...)])` connects to each, beside the agent's model requests (`crewai.json`'s, at the same call); a string that is no URL (`crewai-amp:...`, a server of CrewAI's catalog) and `MCPServerStdio` (a local process) are not reported.
